title: cpKp-Maldi-Vitek: analysis code for 'From routine identification to resistance prediction: reproducible MALDI-TOF MS biomarkers and machine learning classify carbapenemase-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae across spectral data types'
description: R and Python scripts reproducing every analysis of the paper: peak-list and mzML dataset construction, PERMANOVA/PERMADISP and ordination, biomarker discovery with bootstrap stability selection, panel complementarity, UniProt in silico annotation, nine-classifier evaluation under strain-blocked cross-validation, cross-laboratory transfer designs, clonal-structure controls, SHAP, conformal prediction and decision curve analysis, and the scripts that build the main and supplementary figures and tables. Spectra are deposited separately in Zenodo.
